Extract Dublin Core metadata tags

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Scholarly Work</title><meta name=\"DC.title\" content=\"Principles of Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.creator\" content=\"Dr. Alice Johnson\"><meta name=\"DC.date\" content=\"2023-06-15\"><meta name=\"DC.subject\" content=\"Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.publisher\" content=\"Academic Press\"></head><body><p>This is a scholarly article.</p></body></html>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
